title: Synthetic demo: Plant Disease under Field Conditions
abstract: This synthetic example studies plant disease recognition from field images and discusses dataset diversity and real-world generalization as future work.

title: Synthetic demo: Robust Plant Leaf Classification
abstract: This synthetic example proposes a robust plant leaf classifier and discusses robustness to lighting changes and image noise as remaining challenges.

title: Synthetic demo: Explainable Leaf Disease Models
abstract: This synthetic example compares interpretable deep learning methods for plant disease detection and highlights explainability and generalization limitations.

title: Synthetic demo: Lightweight Crop Diagnosis
abstract: This synthetic example targets lightweight crop diagnosis on edge devices and reports benchmark latency.
